landing.hero_desc: Advanced email security that neutralizes phishing threats before they reach your inbox.
landing.features_desc: A comprehensive suite of technologies to validate your domains, monitor sending reputation, and neutralize phishing.
landing.feat_ai_desc: Real-time analysis of every incoming email using a French sovereign AI model, intercepting sophisticated exploits.
landing.feat_remediation_desc: Automatically extract and transfer identified threats natively to the Gmail Trash in under 2 seconds, securing your business.
landing.feat_dmarc_desc: Protect your domain against spoofing and email hijacking by auditing and configuring SPF, DKIM, and DMARC settings.
landing.dark_desc: Sicurre connects directly to your Google Workspace via OAuth. No proxies, no MX record redirection, and zero latency. Install once, secure forever.

landing.dark_check_2: Real-time threat feeds & instant webhook notifications
landing.dark_check_3: Developer-friendly REST API for custom audit logs integration

landing.footer_tagline: The French sovereign anti-phishing protection solution for modern SMBs.
landing.footer_slogan: Secure protection for the modern enterprise.
